instruction.instruction_text: Walk forward, passing a white vanity on your left and a large wardrobe on your right, then enter the hallway straight ahead. Continue straight down the hallway. Turn right into the open area, passing a console table with a wall sconce on your right. Turn left to enter the bedroom, and stop with a teepee on your left, a bed on your right, and a large white wardrobe in front of you.

Walk straight forward, keeping the living room on your left and the dining area with blue-cushioned chairs on your right. Continue down the hallway, and stop in front of the console table with the painting on the wall at the end of the hallway.

Walk forward from the bedroom, past the bed on your right, and go through the open doorway directly ahead of you. Pass an entrance to a bathroom on your right, then turn left to enter the living and dining area. Walk straight forward through this area, passing a dining table on your left. Continue straight, then turn right into the next open hallway. Walk into the kitchen area, with the refrigerator on your left, and then turn right to face the kitchen counter. Stop in front of the sink, directly facing the window.

Walk through the doorway and enter the main room, keeping the living room area with a sofa and coffee table on your left and a TV console on your right. Continue walking straight, passing the dining table on your left, towards the kitchen opening ahead. Go through the opening to enter the kitchen. Walk forward into the kitchen, and stop in front of the window with the plant on your left.

From your current position facing a wall with a television on your left and a clock with a vase below it on your right, turn right towards the doorway. Enter the doorway and walk straight forward into the hallway, passing an opening to a room on your left. Turn left to enter the room. Walk forward past the television on your left, and stop in front of the bed, with the bedside table and wardrobe on your right.

Turn right into the narrow hallway. Walk straight through the narrow hallway and go through the doorway, entering a larger room with a closed door and a floor lamp on your left. Turn slightly right into the main living area. Walk forward, passing a bar with stools on your left and a decorative screen on your right. Proceed straight down the long hallway that appears ahead, with artwork on your right wall and the bar area on your left, towards a statue on a pedestal. At the statue, turn left into another hallway. Walk straight down this hallway, past artwork on your left, and enter the bedroom, stopping next to the pink bed in front of the window.

Exit the bathroom through the doorway, with the sink on your right. Walk straight forward, passing the dining area on your right and the living room area on your left. Then, turn left into the living room and stop in front of the TV and its stand.

Walk forward past the TV on your left and the wardrobe on your right, then go through the doorway. Enter the living room, with a sofa and coffee table on your left and a TV on your right, then continue straight. Stop in front of the window.

Turn right to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom on your right. Turn right into the bedroom and walk towards the white curtains on the far wall. Stop in front of the white curtains, with a nightstand and bed on your right.

Turn right away from the window, keeping the dresser on your right and a wardrobe on your left as you approach the doorway. Go through the doorway to enter the main living area. Walk forward, passing a kitchen counter on your left and a dining table on your right. Continue past a large wooden dresser with a circular mirror on your right, then turn right to enter the kitchen. Walk forward and stop in front of the sink beneath the window.

Walk forward, keeping a light-colored wall on your right, revealing the dining room on your left. Continue forward past a dark shelving unit on your left. Turn right towards the living room, passing the dining table and chairs on your left. Enter the living room and walk forward towards the sofa and the oval coffee table. Stop in front of the coffee table.

Walk forward into the large room, passing the dining table on your left and the living area with a TV straight ahead. Keep the large window on your right. Continue straight, passing a wooden cabinet on your left, and then walk past the first open doorway on your left, which leads to a bathroom. Turn left to enter the second open doorway on your left. Walk straight forward into this new room, passing a tall white cabinet on your right. Continue forward, moving past the tall white cabinet on your right, and stop in front of the window, with a bed on your right and a desk with shelves on your left.

Turn left to enter the room, passing a tall shelving unit on your right. Walk straight through the doorway, past the large abstract painting on your left. Continue walking straight, keeping the desk and chair on your left and the bed on your right. Stop in front of the window.

Walk forward and enter the initial doorway. Continue straight, passing cabinets on your left, until you see a dining table to your right. Turn right into the doorway for the bedroom, passing a monkey-shaped hanger on your right and a bathroom entrance also on your right. Walk straight into the bedroom and stop in front of the bed and window.

Walk forward, passing the refrigerator on your left and the counter with a sink on your right. Go through the doorway ahead, entering a laundry room. Continue walking straight, with a window looking into another room on your left and large windows overlooking a green landscape on your right. Stop in front of the washing machine and the sink unit at the end of the room.

Walk forward from the bedroom through the doorway, keeping the bed on your right. Proceed straight through the short corridor with a tall black shelf on your left, then turn right into the main hallway. Walk straight down this main hallway until you enter the open living and dining area. Continue straight through the living and dining area, keeping the dining table on your right and the television with a cabinet on your left. Next, turn right to enter the hallway on your right, passing the kitchen entrance on your left. Walk straight down this hallway, passing a window with blinds on your right, and stop at the end of the hallway, in front of the wall shelves.

Walk forward through the doorway. Turn right into the living room, passing a sofa and coffee table on your left and a TV on your right. Proceed through the doorway ahead to enter the dining room, with a dining table on your right. Continue forward and stop in front of the kitchen counter.

Walk forward into the open room, passing the dining area with a table on your left and the living room with a sofa straight ahead. Turn left to enter the kitchen area, keeping the kitchen on your left. Continue straight down the hallway, passing display cabinets on your left. Stop in front of the window, with a wardrobe on your left.

From your current position, turn right away from the hanging chair and window, entering the living room. Walk straight, passing the TV and media console on your left and the sofa on your right. Continue straight through the dining area, passing the dining table and chairs on your left. Turn left to enter the kitchen, then walk forward, stopping in front of the kitchen sink with the window directly in front of you.

Go through the doorway to enter the kitchen. Walk straight through the kitchen, passing the kitchen island on your left and the dining table on your right. Continue straight past the dining table on your left, entering the living room. Walk straight forward through the living room, keeping the sofa and armchair on your right, and stop in front of the large TV.
